text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, excuse me, sir.
You dropped this handkerchief...

text_block_list.name: Grandpa
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh...! Sorry about that.
My hearing's a bit poor, you see..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...No, please don't let it bother you.
People often tell me that I don't have much of a presence...
